title: EvidenceAttachService
responsibility: Durably attaches verified records and resolves explicitly addressed video feedback after notes and media exist.

inputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to construct the verification store, evidence branch, history-note repository, LFS adapter, and checker.

inputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.attach.commit
inputs.description: The source revision checked with the stored record and used for its evidence directory, history note, and archive ref; the record must match this revision for integrity checks to pass.

inputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.attach.stored
inputs.description: The stored verification record and the directory containing its record.json, evidence, and logs; integrity checks inspect the record and its files, then dependency resolution uses the record fields.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.record
inputs.description: Verification record ID; a flag cannot be resolved by the same record it originally flagged.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.capture
inputs.description: One retained video capture with source owner, viewport, addressed flag IDs and original capture timestamp.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.flags
inputs.description: Immutable reviewer flag snapshot including resolved identities and every current unresolved owner/clip/viewport obligation.

inputs.name: resolveAttachedVideoFlags.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: resolveAttachedVideoFlags.record
inputs.description: Sealed verification record whose present clip slots are checked against current reviewer standing.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.record
inputs.description: Sealed verification record whose present clip slots are checked against current reviewer standing.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.attached
inputs.description: Durable evidence receipt whose record media, source note and archive already exist.

outputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.attach
outputs.description: Resolves to the record id, outcome, source commit, evidence pointer, note ref, archive ref, and whether the evidence commit was newly created. The created flag is false when the exact record was already attached.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when record integrity has problems, an inherited record is unavailable, or the source commit cannot be kept reachable at its archive ref. Awaited filesystem and adapter operations may also reject with their own errors. Current reviewer obligations also refuse missing, wrong-owner, late or predating replacements after durable attachment without deleting evidence.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.record
inputs.description: Verification record ID; a flag cannot be resolved by the same record it originally flagged.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.capture
inputs.description: One retained video capture with source owner, viewport, addressed flag IDs and original capture timestamp.

inputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure.flags
inputs.description: Immutable reviewer flag snapshot including resolved identities and every current unresolved owner/clip/viewport obligation.

outputs.name: attachedVideoFlagFailure
outputs.description: Current reviewer-admission diagnostic for a retained capture, or undefined without changing historical media integrity.

inputs.name: resolveAttachedVideoFlags.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: resolveAttachedVideoFlags.record
inputs.description: Sealed verification record whose present clip slots are checked against current reviewer standing.

outputs.name: resolveAttachedVideoFlags
outputs.description: Explicit owning flag resolutions appended only after durable notes exist; late or old captures reject while preserving pending flags.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Current reviewer evidence is corrupt, exceeds finite capture-environment bounds, or the replacement omits, misowns or predates a required flag.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.record
inputs.description: Sealed verification record whose present clip slots are checked against current reviewer standing.

inputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment.attached
inputs.description: Durable evidence receipt whose record media, source note and archive already exist.

outputs.name: resolvedVideoAttachment
outputs.description: Original durable receipt after current pending obligations have been rechecked and explicit acknowledgments resolved.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Current reviewer evidence is corrupt, exceeds finite capture-environment bounds, or the replacement omits, misowns or predates a required flag.

inputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.constructor.root

outputs.name: EvidenceAttachService.constructor
outputs.description: The constructor returns a new EvidenceAttachService instance with its repositories, LFS adapter, checker, and per-instance attached-record cache initialized.
